mapper.select: SELECT TOP 1 ITMMASTER.ITMREF_0 FROM ITMMASTER WHERE ITMMASTER.ITMREF_0=#{PnRoot}

WITH T0 AS ( SELECT DISTINCT ITMMASTER.ITMREF_0 AS PNROOT, ITMMASTER.ITMREF_0 AS PN, ITMMASTER.ITMDES1_0 + IIF(ITMMASTER.ITMDES2_0 ='', '', ' '+ ITMMASTER.ITMDES2_0) + IIF(ITMMASTER.ITMDES3_0 ='', '', ' '+ ITMMASTER.ITMDES3_0) AS Description /* IIF(ECCSTA.ITMREF_0 IS NULL, ITMMASTER.ITMREF_0, IIF(ECCSTA.ECCVALMAJ_0='#', ECCSTA.ITMREF_0, IIF(ECCSTA.ECCVALMAJ_0='-', ECCSTA.ITMREF_0, ECCSTA.ITMREF_0 + '_' + ECCSTA.ECCVALMAJ_0 ) ) ) AS PN */ FROM EXPLOIT.ITMMASTER ITMMASTER LEFT JOIN EXPLOIT.ECCSTA ECCSTA ON ITMMASTER.ITMREF_0 = ECCSTA.ITMREF_0 WHERE ITMMASTER.ITMREF_0 LIKE #{PnRoot} OR (ECCSTA.ITMREF_0 + '_' + ECCSTA.ECCVALMAJ_0 = #{PnRoot}) ORDER BY ITMMASTER.ITMREF_0 DESC, PN OFFSET 0 ROWS FETCH NEXT #{Count} ROWS ONLY ), T1 AS ( SELECT DISTINCT ITMMASTER.ITMREF_0 AS PNROOT, ITMMASTER.ITMREF_0 AS PN, ITMMASTER.ITMDES1_0 + IIF(ITMMASTER.ITMDES2_0 ='', '', ' '+ ITMMASTER.ITMDES2_0) + IIF(ITMMASTER.ITMDES3_0 ='', '', ' '+ ITMMASTER.ITMDES3_0) AS Description FROM EXPLOIT.ITMMASTER ITMMASTER LEFT JOIN EXPLOIT.ECCSTA ECCSTA ON ITMMASTER.ITMREF_0 = ECCSTA.ITMREF_0 WHERE ITMMASTER.ITMDES1_0 LIKE #{PnRoot} OR ITMMASTER.ITMDES2_0 LIKE #{PnRoot} OR ITMMASTER.ITMDES3_0 LIKE #{PnRoot} ORDER BY ITMMASTER.ITMREF_0 DESC, PN OFFSET 0 ROWS FETCH NEXT #{Count} ROWS ONLY ) SELECT * FROM T0 UNION SELECT * FROM T1
SELECT DISTINCT ITMMASTER.ITMREF_0 AS PNROOT, ITMMASTER.ITMREF_0 AS PN, ORDER BY ITMMASTER.ITMREF_0 DESC, PN OFFSET 0 ROWS FETCH NEXT #{Count} ROWS ONLY

SELECT TOP 3 ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY ECCSTA.ZECCREVMAJ_0 DESC) AS ROWID, ITMMASTER.ITMREF_0 AS PNROOT, IIF(ITMMASTER.ECCFLG_0 = 2, ITMMASTER.ITMREF_0 + '_' + ECCSTA.ECCVALMAJ_0, ITMMASTER.ITMREF_0) AS PN, ITMMASTER.TSICOD_0 AS Cat, ECCSTA.ECCVALMAJ_0 AS Version, ITMMASTER.ITMDES1_0 + IIF(ITMMASTER.ITMDES2_0 ='', '', ' '+ ITMMASTER.ITMDES2_0) + IIF(ITMMASTER.ITMDES3_0 ='', '', ' '+ ITMMASTER.ITMDES3_0) AS Description, ITMMASTER.YITM_COMSTA_0 AS Comment, IIF(ECCSTA.EXNFLG_0=2, 5, ITMMASTER.ITMSTA_0) AS Status, ITMMASTER.CREDAT_0 AS CreateDate FROM EXPLOIT.ITMMASTER ITMMASTER LEFT JOIN EXPLOIT.ECCSTA ECCSTA ON ITMMASTER.ITMREF_0 = ECCSTA.ITMREF_0 WHERE ITMMASTER.ITMREF_0 = #{PnRoot}

SELECT YITMINDUS.YCHKDWG_0 checkDrawing, APLSTD.LANMES_0 typo, YITMINDUS.YCOMPLEX_0 complex, YITMINDUS.YWAROUT_0 warnManufTool, YITMINDUS.YWARCE_0 warnCE, YITMINDUS.YWAREXTRA_0 warnExtraSize, YITMINDUS.YWARCAST_0 warnCasters, YITMINDUS.YWARLIFT_0 warnLifting, YITMINDUS.YCOMCOM_0 isComponents, YITMINDUS.YMATALU_0 rawAluminum, YITMINDUS.YMATSTL_0 rawSteel, YITMINDUS.YMATPLA_0 rawPlastic, YITMINDUS.YMATVAR_0 rawVariousMaterial, YITMINDUS.YMATSPE_0 rawSpecific, YITMINDUS.YTTHHTRT_0 heatTreatment, YITMINDUS.YMACGEA_0 machineGrinding, YITMINDUS.YMACGRI_0 machineGear, YITMINDUS.YTTSSTD_0 ttsStand, YITMINDUS.YTTSSPE_0 ttsSpecific, YITMINDUS.YTTSPAI_0 ttsPainting, YITMINDUS.YTTSPLC_0 ttsPlastic, YITMINDUS.YPCKSPB_0 specialPackingBox, YITMINDUS.YCONLOT_0 testLoad, YITMINDUS.YCONHYD_0 testHydraulic, YITMINDUS.YCONBAT_0 testBalancing, YITMINDUS.YCONVAR_0 testVarious, YITMINDUS.YCONCAL_0 controlCalibration, YITMINDUS.YCONSPE_0 controlSpecific, YITMINDUS.YCONGEO_0 control3D FROM EXPLOIT.YITMINDUS YITMINDUS LEFT JOIN EXPLOIT.APLSTD APLSTD ON APLSTD.LAN_0 = 'ENG' AND LANCHP_0 ='6557' AND APLSTD.LANNUM_0 = YITMINDUS.YFAMPN_0 WHERE ITMREF_0 = #{PnRoot}

SELECT BPARTNER.BPRNUM_0 AS BPCode, BPARTNER.BPRNAM_0 + IIF(BPARTNER.BPRNAM_1 = '', '', BPARTNER.BPRNAM_1) AS BPName, ITMREFBPS_0 AS OptionPN, IIF(ITMDESBPS_0 != '', ITMDESBPS_0, ITMMASTER.ITMDES1_0 + IIF(ITMMASTER.ITMDES2_0 ='', '', ' '+ ITMMASTER.ITMDES2_0) + IIF(ITMMASTER.ITMDES3_0 ='', '', ' '+ ITMMASTER.ITMDES3_0)) AS Description FROM EXPLOIT.ITMBPS ITMBPS LEFT JOIN EXPLOIT.BPARTNER ON ITMBPS.BPSNUM_0 = BPARTNER.BPRNUM_0 LEFT JOIN EXPLOIT.ITMMASTER ON ITMBPS.ITMREF_0 = ITMMASTER.ITMREF_0 WHERE ITMBPS.ITMREF_0 = #{PnRoot} AND ITMBPS.ITMREF_0 != ITMBPS.ITMREFBPS_0
UNION SELECT BPARTNER.BPRNUM_0 AS BPCode, BPARTNER.BPRNAM_0 + IIF(BPARTNER.BPRNAM_1 = '', '', BPARTNER.BPRNAM_1) AS BPName, ITMREFBPC_0 AS OptionPN, IIF(ITMDESBPC_0 != '', ITMDESBPC_0, ITMMASTER.ITMDES1_0 + IIF(ITMMASTER.ITMDES2_0 ='', '', ' '+ ITMMASTER.ITMDES2_0) + IIF(ITMMASTER.ITMDES3_0 ='', '', ' '+ ITMMASTER.ITMDES3_0)) AS Description FROM EXPLOIT.ITMBPC ITMBPC LEFT JOIN EXPLOIT.BPARTNER ON ITMBPC.BPCNUM_0 = BPARTNER.BPRNUM_0 LEFT JOIN EXPLOIT.ITMMASTER ON ITMBPC.ITMREF_0 = ITMMASTER.ITMREF_0 WHERE ITMBPC.ITMREFBPC_0 = #{PnRoot} AND ITMBPC.ITMREF_0 != ITMBPC.ITMREFBPC_0

SELECT IIF (ITMMASTER.ECCFLG_0 = 2, ITMMASTER.ITMREF_0 + '_' + ECCSTA.ECCVALMAJ_0, ITMMASTER.ITMREF_0) AS PN, ITMMASTER.ITMDES1_0 + IIF(ITMMASTER.ITMDES2_0 ='', '', ' '+ ITMMASTER.ITMDES2_0) + IIF(ITMMASTER.ITMDES3_0 ='', '', ' '+ ITMMASTER.ITMDES3_0) AS Description, IIF ( ECCSTA.EXNFLG_0 = 2, 'Obsolete', ( CASE WHEN ITMMASTER.ITMSTA_0 = 1 THEN 'Active' WHEN ITMMASTER.ITMSTA_0 = 2 THEN 'InDevelopment' WHEN ITMMASTER.ITMSTA_0 = 3 THEN 'OnShortage' WHEN ITMMASTER.ITMSTA_0 = 4 THEN 'NotRenewed' WHEN ITMMASTER.ITMSTA_0 = 5 THEN 'Obsolete' WHEN ITMMASTER.ITMSTA_0 = 6 THEN 'NotUsable' ELSE 'UNK' END ) ) AS PNStatus, ITMMASTER.YITM_SUP_0 AS WC, IIF ( SORDERQ.YSOQ_PJTORI_0 = '', SORDERQ.YSOH_PJT_0, SORDERQ.YSOQ_PJTORI_0 ) AS ProjectNO, SORDER.BPCORD_0 AS CustomerCode, SORDER.BPCNAM_0 AS CustomerName FROM EXPLOIT.SORDERQ AS SORDERQ LEFT JOIN EXPLOIT.SORDER ON SORDERQ.SOHNUM_0 = SORDER.SOHNUM_0 LEFT JOIN EXPLOIT.ECCSTA AS ECCSTA ON SORDERQ.ITMREF_0 = ECCSTA.ITMREF_0 AND SORDERQ.ECCVALMAJ_0 = ECCSTA.ECCVALMAJ_0 LEFT JOIN EXPLOIT.ITMMASTER AS ITMMASTER ON ITMMASTER.ITMREF_0 = SORDERQ.ITMREF_0 WHERE SORDERQ.SOQSTA_0 != 3 AND ITMMASTER.ITMSTA_0 != 1 AND SORDERQ.SALFCY_0 = #{Site}

WITH T0 AS ( SELECT DISTINCT ITMMASTER.ITMREF_0 FROM EXPLOIT.ITMMASTER ITMMASTER WHERE ITMMASTER.ITMDES1_0 LIKE #{PnRoot} )
SELECT STOCK.STOFCY_0 AS StockSite, STOCK.ITMREF_0 AS PN, SUM(STOCK.QTYSTU_0) OVER (PARTITION BY STOCK.ITMREF_0, STOCK.STOFCY_0) AS Qty, 'P' AS Type FROM EXPLOIT.STOCK STOCK LEFT JOIN EXPLOIT.ITMMASTER ITMMASTER ON ITMMASTER.ITMREF_0 = STOCK.ITMREF_0 WHERE ITMMASTER.ITMREF_0 = #{PnRoot} -- NON Repair return AND STOCK.STA_0 != 'RE'
UNION
SELECT STOCK.STOFCY_0 AS StockSite, STOCK.ITMREF_0 + '(RE)' AS PN, SUM(STOCK.QTYSTU_0) OVER (PARTITION BY STOCK.ITMREF_0, STOCK.STOFCY_0) AS Qty, 'RE' AS Type FROM EXPLOIT.STOCK STOCK LEFT JOIN EXPLOIT.ITMMASTER ITMMASTER ON ITMMASTER.ITMREF_0 = STOCK.ITMREF_0 WHERE ITMMASTER.ITMREF_0 = #{PnRoot} -- Repair return AND STOCK.STA_0 = 'RE'
UNION
SELECT STOCK.STOFCY_0 AS StockSite, STOCK.ITMREF_0 AS PN, SUM(STOCK.QTYSTU_0) OVER (PARTITION BY STOCK.ITMREF_0, STOCK.STOFCY_0) AS Qty, 'C' AS Type FROM EXPLOIT.STOCK STOCK INNER JOIN T0 ON STOCK.ITMREF_0 = T0.ITMREF_0

SELECT SORDERP.SALFCY_0 AS SalesSite, SORDERP.ITMREF_0 AS PN, SORDER.ORDDAT_0 AS OrderDate, SDELIVERYD.SHIDAT_0 AS ShipDate, DateDiff(day, SORDER.ORDDAT_0, SDELIVERYD.SHIDAT_0) AS Duration FROM EXPLOIT.SORDER SORDER LEFT JOIN EXPLOIT.SORDERP SORDERP ON SORDERP.SOHNUM_0 = SORDER.SOHNUM_0 INNER JOIN EXPLOIT.SDELIVERYD SDELIVERYD ON SORDERP.SOHNUM_0 = SDELIVERYD.SOHNUM_0 AND SORDERP.SOPLIN_0 = SDELIVERYD.SOPLIN_0 WHERE SORDERP.ITMREF_0 = #{PnRoot} ORDER BY OrderDate DESC

SELECT SORDERP.SALFCY_0 AS SalesSite, SORDERP.SOHNUM_0 AS OrderNO, SORDER.ORDDAT_0 AS OrderDate, SORDER.BPCORD_0 AS CustomerCode, SORDER.BPCNAM_0 AS CustomerName, SORDERP.ITMREF_0 AS PN, SORDERQ.QTY_0 AS QTY, SORDERP.NETPRI_0 AS NetPrice, SORDER.CUR_0 AS Currency, SORDER.EECICT_0 AS TradeTerm FROM EXPLOIT.SORDER SORDER LEFT JOIN EXPLOIT.SORDERP SORDERP ON SORDERP.SOHNUM_0 = SORDER.SOHNUM_0 INNER JOIN EXPLOIT.SORDERQ SORDERQ ON SORDERQ.SOHNUM_0 = SORDERP.SOHNUM_0 AND SORDERQ.SOPLIN_0 = SORDERP.SOPLIN_0 WHERE SORDERP.NETPRI_0 > 0 AND SORDERP.ITMREF_0 = #{PnRoot} ORDER BY OrderDate DESC

SELECT SQUOTED.SALFCY_0 AS SalesSite, SQUOTED.SQHNUM_0 AS QuoteNO, SQUOTED.QUODAT_0 AS QuoteDate, SQUOTE.BPCORD_0 AS CustomerCode, SQUOTE.BPCNAM_0 AS CustomerName, SQUOTED.ITMREF_0 AS PN, SQUOTED.QTY_0 AS QTY, SQUOTED.NETPRI_0 AS NetPrice, SQUOTE.CUR_0 AS Currency, SQUOTED.ORDFLG_0 AS OrderFlag, SQUOTED.SOHNUM_0 AS OrderNO, SQUOTE.EECICT_0 AS TradeTerm FROM EXPLOIT.SQUOTE SQUOTE LEFT JOIN EXPLOIT.SQUOTED SQUOTED ON SQUOTED.SQHNUM_0=SQUOTE.SQHNUM_0 WHERE SQUOTED.NETPRI_0 > 0 AND SQUOTED.ITMREF_0 = #{PnRoot} ORDER BY QuoteDate DESC

SELECT DISTINCT PORDERP.PRHFCY_0 AS PurchaseSite, OPPOR.OPPNUM_0 AS ProjectNO, OPPOR.OPPEXTNUM_0 AS OrderPN, OPPOR.CREDAT_0 AS OrderDate, PORDERP.POHNUM_0 AS PurchaseNO, PORDERP.POPLIN_0 As Line, PORDER.BPSNUM_0 AS VendorCode, PORDER.BPRNAM_0 AS VendorName, PORDERP.ITMREF_0 AS PurchasePN, PORDERP.ITMDES1_0 + IIF(PORDERP.ITMDES2_0 ='', '', ' '+ PORDERP.ITMDES2_0) AS Description, PORDER.CUR_0 AS Currency, PORDERP.NETPRI_0 AS NetPrice, PORDERQ.QTYPUU_0 AS Qty FROM EXPLOIT.PORDERP PORDERP INNER JOIN EXPLOIT.PORDERQ PORDERQ ON PORDERQ.POHNUM_0 = PORDERP.POHNUM_0 AND PORDERQ.POPLIN_0 = PORDERP.POPLIN_0 INNER JOIN EXPLOIT.PORDER PORDER ON PORDER.POHNUM_0 = PORDERP.POHNUM_0 INNER JOIN EXPLOIT.OPPOR OPPOR ON PORDERP.PJT_0 = OPPOR.OPPNUM_0 OR PORDERP.PJT_0 = OPPOR.ZOPPNUMORI_0 WHERE PORDERP.PJT_0 != '' -- CDE: Order project -- ART: Stock project AND OPPOR.OPPTYP_0 IN ('CDE','ART') AND OPPOR.OPPEXTNUM_0 = #{PnRoot} AND PORDERP.NETPRI_0 > 0 ORDER BY PurchaseSite ASC, ProjectNO DESC, OrderDate DESC, PurchaseNO ASC, Line ASC

WITH T0 AS ( SELECT ITMREFBPS_0 AS OptionPN FROM EXPLOIT.ITMBPS WHERE ITMREF_0 = #{PnRoot} AND ITMREF_0 != ITMREFBPS_0
UNION SELECT ITMREF_0 AS OptionPN FROM EXPLOIT.ITMBPS WHERE ITMREFBPS_0 = #{PnRoot} AND ITMREF_0 !=ITMREFBPS_0
UNION SELECT ITMREF_0 AS OptionPN FROM EXPLOIT.ITMBPC WHERE ITMREFBPC_0 = #{PnRoot} AND ITMREF_0 != ITMREFBPC_0
UNION SELECT ITMREFBPC_0 AS OptionPN FROM EXPLOIT.ITMBPC WHERE ITMREF_0 = #{PnRoot} AND ITMREF_0 != ITMREFBPC_0
-- include self UNION SELECT #{PnRoot} AS OptionPN ), T1 AS ( SELECT DISTINCT T0.OptionPN AS ITMREF_0 FROM T0
--- PNOG style ITMREF_0 UNION SELECT DISTINCT ITMMASTER.ITMREF_0 FROM EXPLOIT.ITMMASTER ITMMASTER WHERE ITMMASTER.ITMDES1_0 LIKE #{PnRoot} )
SELECT DISTINCT STOCK.STOFCY_0 AS StockSite, STOCK.ITMREF_0 AS PN, SUM(STOCK.QTYSTU_0) OVER (PARTITION BY STOCK.ITMREF_0, STOCK.STOFCY_0) AS Qty, 'C' AS Type FROM EXPLOIT.STOCK STOCK INNER JOIN T1 ON STOCK.ITMREF_0 = T1.ITMREF_0

WITH T0 AS ( SELECT ITMREFBPS_0 AS OptionPN FROM EXPLOIT.ITMBPS WHERE ITMREF_0 = #{PnRoot} AND ITMREF_0 != ITMREFBPS_0
UNION SELECT ITMREF_0 AS OptionPN FROM EXPLOIT.ITMBPS WHERE ITMREFBPS_0 = #{PnRoot} AND ITMREF_0 !=ITMREFBPS_0
UNION SELECT ITMREF_0 AS OptionPN FROM EXPLOIT.ITMBPC WHERE ITMREFBPC_0 = #{PnRoot} AND ITMREF_0 != ITMREFBPC_0
UNION SELECT ITMREFBPC_0 AS OptionPN FROM EXPLOIT.ITMBPC WHERE ITMREF_0 = #{PnRoot} AND ITMREF_0 != ITMREFBPC_0
-- include self UNION SELECT #{PnRoot} AS OptionPN ), T1 AS ( SELECT DISTINCT T0.OptionPN AS ITMREF_0 FROM T0
--- PNOG style ITMREF_0 UNION SELECT DISTINCT ITMMASTER.ITMREF_0 FROM EXPLOIT.ITMMASTER ITMMASTER WHERE ITMMASTER.ITMDES1_0 LIKE #{PnRoot} )
SELECT PORDERQ.PRHFCY_0 AS PurchaseSite, PORDERQ.ITMREF_0 AS PN, PORDERQ.POHNUM_0 AS PurchaseNO, PORDERQ.POPLIN_0 As Line, PORDER.BPSNUM_0 AS VendorCode, PORDER.BPRNAM_0 AS VendorName, PORDERQ.ORDDAT_0 AS PurchaseDate, PRECEIPTD.RCPDAT_0 AS ReceiptDate, DateDiff(day, PORDERQ.ORDDAT_0, PRECEIPTD.RCPDAT_0) AS Duration, PORDERQ.QTYPUU_0 AS Qty, PORDERQ.PUU_0 AS Unit FROM T1 INNER JOIN EXPLOIT.PORDERQ PORDERQ ON PORDERQ.ITMREF_0 = T1.ITMREF_0 INNER JOIN EXPLOIT.PRECEIPTD PRECEIPTD ON PORDERQ.POHNUM_0 = PRECEIPTD.POHNUM_0 AND PORDERQ.POPLIN_0 = PRECEIPTD.POPLIN_0 LEFT JOIN EXPLOIT.PORDER PORDER ON PORDER.POHNUM_0 = PORDERQ.POHNUM_0 WHERE PORDERQ.POHNUM_0 != '' AND PORDERQ.QTYPUU_0 > 0 AND PORDERQ.ITMREF_0 = #{PnRoot} ORDER BY PORDERQ.ORDDAT_0 DESC

WITH T0 AS ( SELECT ITMREFBPS_0 AS OptionPN FROM EXPLOIT.ITMBPS WHERE ITMREF_0 = #{PnRoot} AND ITMREF_0 != ITMREFBPS_0
UNION SELECT ITMREF_0 AS OptionPN FROM EXPLOIT.ITMBPS WHERE ITMREFBPS_0 = #{PnRoot} AND ITMREF_0 !=ITMREFBPS_0
UNION SELECT ITMREF_0 AS OptionPN FROM EXPLOIT.ITMBPC WHERE ITMREFBPC_0 = #{PnRoot} AND ITMREF_0 != ITMREFBPC_0
UNION SELECT ITMREFBPC_0 AS OptionPN FROM EXPLOIT.ITMBPC WHERE ITMREF_0 = #{PnRoot} AND ITMREF_0 != ITMREFBPC_0
-- include self UNION SELECT #{PnRoot} AS OptionPN ), T1 AS ( SELECT DISTINCT T0.OptionPN AS ITMREF_0 FROM T0
--- PNOG style ITMREF_0 UNION SELECT DISTINCT ITMMASTER.ITMREF_0 FROM EXPLOIT.ITMMASTER ITMMASTER WHERE ITMMASTER.ITMDES1_0 LIKE #{PnRoot} )
SELECT DISTINCT PORDERP.PRHFCY_0 AS PurchaseSite, PORDERP.PJT_0 AS ProjectNO, PORDERP.CREDAT_0 AS PurchaseDate, PORDERP.POHNUM_0 AS PurchaseNO, PORDERP.POPLIN_0 As Line, PORDER.BPSNUM_0 AS VendorCode, PORDER.BPRNAM_0 AS VendorName, PORDERP.ITMREF_0 AS PurchasePN, PORDERP.ITMDES1_0 + IIF(PORDERP.ITMDES2_0 ='', '', ' '+ PORDERP.ITMDES2_0) AS Description, PORDER.CUR_0 AS Currency, PORDERP.NETPRI_0 AS NetPrice, PORDERQ.QTYPUU_0 AS Qty, PORDERQ.PUU_0 AS Unit FROM T1 INNER JOIN EXPLOIT.PORDERP PORDERP ON PORDERP.ITMREF_0 = T1.ITMREF_0 INNER JOIN EXPLOIT.PORDERQ PORDERQ ON PORDERQ.POHNUM_0 = PORDERP.POHNUM_0 AND PORDERQ.POPLIN_0 = PORDERP.POPLIN_0 INNER JOIN EXPLOIT.PORDER PORDER ON PORDER.POHNUM_0 = PORDERP.POHNUM_0 WHERE PORDERP.PJT_0 != '' AND T1.ITMREF_0 = #{PnRoot} AND PORDERP.NETPRI_0 > 0 ORDER BY PurchaseDate DESC, PurchaseNO ASC, Line ASC
